_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Thomas Seltzer (1875-1943), translator and publisher: Gorky, Andreyev, Gogol, Sudermann, Ostwald, 1908-1916. US public domain (pre-1931). Adele Szold Seltzer's translations (Hauptmann's Atlantis) are hers, not his, and are left out. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 17); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
